elemental_profile.motto: Passionate courage, magnetic leadership, and radiant inspiration.
elemental_profile.description: Fire Hand: Long, vibrant palm with dynamic posture. Boundless passion, charisma, adventurous spirit, and natural leadership.

life.title: Life Line (Vitality & Life Path)
life.curve_pattern: Wide, sweeping crescent wrapping generously around the Mount of Venus.
life.vitality_trait: Expansive life force, high physical stamina, warmth, and generous hospitality.
life.resilience: Higher nervous and spiritual energy; benefits greatly from meditation, nature grounding, and mindful nutrition.
life.journey: Long, continuous path reflecting a rich, multifaceted life journey filled with diverse chapters.
life.summary: Expansive life force, high physical stamina, warmth, and generous hospitality. Higher nervous and spiritual energy; benefits greatly from meditation, nature grounding, and mindful nutrition. Long, continuous path reflecting a rich, multifaceted life journey filled with diverse chapters.

head.title: Head Line (Wisdom & Mental Faculties)
head.slope_pattern: Traverses straight across the palm toward the Mount of Mars.
head.intellect_style: Sharp analytical mindset grounded in logic, realism, empirical evidence, and pragmatic execution.
head.focus_level: Agile, nimble thought process with curiosity spanning many simultaneous interests.
head.career_aptitude: Technology, engineering, quantitative research, executive management, and structured systems.
head.summary: Sharp analytical mindset grounded in logic, realism, empirical evidence, and pragmatic execution. Agile, nimble thought process with curiosity spanning many simultaneous interests. Best suited for environments requiring technology, engineering, quantitative research, executive management, and structured systems..

heart.title: Heart Line (Emotional Temperament & Romance)
heart.romantic_style: Pragmatic and composed in affections. Expresses love through tangible dedication, loyalty, and steadfast acts of service.
heart.empathy_type: Stoic resilience; handles interpersonal challenges with serene composure.
heart.summary: Pragmatic and composed in affections. Expresses love through tangible dedication, loyalty, and steadfast acts of service. Stoic resilience; handles interpersonal challenges with serene composure.

fate.title: Fate Line (Destiny & Career Alignment)
fate.presence: Emergent, flexible path adapting gracefully to evolving ambitions.
fate.destiny_style: Dynamic career journey characterized by self-reinvention, expanding horizons, and timely opportunities.
fate.vocation: Multidisciplinary career, collaborative ventures, creative independence.
fate.summary: Emergent, flexible path adapting gracefully to evolving ambitions. Dynamic career journey characterized by self-reinvention, expanding horizons, and timely opportunities. Propels you toward multidisciplinary career, collaborative ventures, creative independence..

mounts.name: Mount of Jupiter
mounts.interpretation: High moral conviction, natural mentorship abilities, and inspirational authority.

mounts.name: Mount of Venus
mounts.interpretation: Rich aesthetic appreciation, warm hospitality, sensory delight, and generous spirit.

mounts.name: Mount of Luna
mounts.interpretation: Vivid dream world, strong instinctual gut feelings, poetic imagination, and love of travel.

mounts.name: Mount of Sun (Apollo)
mounts.interpretation: Innate magnetism, sunny optimism, love of elegance, and flair for creative expression.

auspicious_signs.name: The Mystic Cross (La Croix Mystique)
auspicious_signs.significance: Located in the quadrangle between Heart and Head lines. Indicates keen metaphysical intuition, sixth sense, and natural psychological insight.

auspicious_signs.name: The Ring of Solomon
auspicious_signs.significance: Curved semi-circle below Mount of Jupiter. Signifies judicial wisdom, innate empathy, and talent for guiding others.

auspicious_signs.name: The Great Triangle of Vitality
auspicious_signs.significance: Formed by intersection of Life, Head, and Fate lines. Reflects balanced intellectual and physical vitality with high problem-solving endurance.

mindful_guidance: Honor your Fire element by grounding decisions in Passionate courage, magnetic leadership, and radiant inspiration..
Your Head and Heart lines show a strong synergy between emotional intuition and rational focus.
Nurture your Fate Line by setting clear milestones while staying receptive to serendipitous opportunities.
Practice restorative grounding to keep your Mount of Venus vitality replenished.
